title: incident-bot: add runbook generation and SLO diagnostic utilities
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: On-call engineers and SREs need faster, consistent diagnostics when SLOs or alerts fire. This PR adds an automated runbook generator and a set of SLO diagnostic utilities to the incident-bot and slo-toolkit so on-call can run a single command to collect relevant traces, recent latency histograms, recent error windows, and a suggested remediation checklist. What this changes: 1) incident-bot: new /diagnose endpoint and runbook templating utilities, plus a k8s job helper to run the collection against a tenant's Dedicated cluster; 2) slo-toolkit: CLI subcommand 'slo diagnose' that aggregates metrics, traces, and config checks; 3) docs: runbooks.md with example playbooks and runbook customization hooks; 4) tests: integration test that simulates an SLO breach and validates diagnostics payload. Backwards compatibility: most server endpoints are opt-in behind feature flag INCIDENT_RUNBOOKS=true. The generator is idempotent and does not change existing alert behavior. Checklist: [x] unit tests [x] integration test [x] docs [x] manual on-call walkthrough done. Usage notes: see slo-toolkit/docs/runbooks.md for example commands and incident-bot/README for k8s job usage. Rollout: feature flag gated, toggleable per-namespace. Impact: reduces mean-time-to-resolution for first-responders by providing curated diagnostics and actionable remediation steps.

notes_for_oncall: Run `slo-toolkit diagnose --slo <id> --window 5m` or trigger incident-bot runbook job in namespace. Outputs a JSON diagnostics bundle and suggested remediation steps. Follow runbooks.md for escalation path.
